+def load_image_bytes(source: str | None) -> bytes | None:
+    """Read inline images or objects from the configured bucket."""
+    if not source:
+        return None
+    try:
+        if source.startswith("data:image/"):
+            header, payload = source.split(",", 1)
+            if header.endswith(";base64"):
+                return base64.b64decode(payload)
+            return None
+
+        path = urlsplit(source)
+        if path.scheme or path.netloc:
+            host = urlsplit(settings.STORAGE_HOST or "")
+            prefix = host.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+            if (path.scheme not in ("http", "https") or path.scheme != host.scheme
+                    or path.netloc.lower() != host.netloc.lower()
+                    or not path.path.startswith(prefix)):
+                return None
+            key = unquote(path.path[len(prefix):])
+        else:
+            key = source
+
+        if ("\\" in key or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/"))
+                or any(ord(char) < 32 for char in key)):
+            return None
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception:
+        return None

+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+import requests
+from fastapi import HTTPException
+from PIL import Image
+
+from app.api.v1.endpoints.episodes import export_episode
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+from app.services.reference_board import download_image
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def sources():
+    buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new("RGB", (2, 3)).save(buffer, "PNG")
+    png = buffer.getvalue()
+    key = storage.upload_image(png, "cuts", "example")
+    data = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(png).decode()
+    return png, [key, f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{key}", data]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def forbid_http(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "request", lambda *a, **kw: pytest.fail("Unexpected HTTP request"))
+
+
+def test_ai_and_reference_board_sources(sources):
+    png, allowed = sources
+    service = BaseAIService()
+    for source in allowed:
+        assert service._download_image(source) == png
+        assert download_image(source).size == (2, 3)
+    for source in ["http://private.invalid/image", "//private.invalid/image",
+                   f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}.invalid/image"]:
+        assert service._download_image(source) is None
+        assert download_image(source) is None
+
+
+def export_sources(format, cuts):
+    session = Mock()
+    session.get.return_value = SimpleNamespace(title="Panels", deleted_at=None)
+    session.exec.return_value.all.return_value = [
+        SimpleNamespace(cut_order=i, image_path=source) for i, source in cuts
+    ]
+    return export_episode(session=session, episode_id=None, format=format, current_user_id="member")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("format", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("partial", [True, False])
+def test_export_reports_only_omitted_cuts(format, partial, sources):
+    png, allowed = sources
+    cuts = list(zip([2, 4, 9], allowed))
+    if partial:
+        cuts.extend([(1, None), (3, "https://private.invalid/image"),
+                     (6, "cuts/absent.png"), (12, "data:image/png;base64,YmFk")])
+    response = export_sources(format, sorted(cuts))
+    if partial:
+        assert response.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "1,3,6,12"
+    else:
+        assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in response.headers
+    if format == "zip":
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.body)) as archive:
+            names = ["Panels_02.png", "Panels_04.png", "Panels_09.png"]
+            assert archive.namelist() == names + (["missing.txt"] if partial else [])
+            assert all(archive.read(name) == png for name in names)
+            if partial:
+                assert archive.read("missing.txt").splitlines() == [b"1", b"3", b"6", b"12"]
+    else:
+        assert response.media_type == "image/png"
+
+
+def test_all_cuts_missing():
+    cuts = [(5, None), (8, "cuts/absent.png")]
+    response = export_sources("zip", cuts)
+    assert response.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "5,8"
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.body)) as archive:
+        assert archive.namelist() == ["missing.txt"]
+        assert archive.read("missing.txt").splitlines() == [b"5", b"8"]
+    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as error:
+        export_sources("webtoon", cuts)
+    assert error.value.status_code == 400
+    assert error.value.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "5,8"
